main_text.head: CAP. IIII. DE QVARTO TITVLO PAPAE, VIDELICET, SPECVLATOR.
main_text.p: “Quartum nomen Pontificis Speculator est; ipse enim prop-tereà in altissimo fastigio sedet specula Pastoralis, ut S. Augustinus loquitur in principio quatuor librorum ad Bonifa-cium Papam. ---- Pag.31.
main_text.head: I. ANIMADVERSIO.

head.i: Augustinum Bonifacio Papae fastigium concessisse, fastum adimisse.

main_text.p: DUm Roma adhuc metropolis, & quasi emporium erat orbis Christiani, non difficile fuit Augustino in ea Pastoralis specula fastigium altissimum intueri; quando nimirum, propter loci amplitudinem, Papae, non quidem Super alios, sed tamen Præ alijs effulgebat authoritas. Exemplum nobis luculentum erit (nè longius repetamus) idem Supra c.1.§.9.Bonifacius, qui, in causa {*}Appellationis, Speculæ suæ fastigium paulò altius erigens, quàm par erat, ab Africanis Patribus (inter quos Augustinus pars magna fuit) ab isthoc culmine, non sine ignominia, deiectus penitus obmutuit. Quodsi Africani Bonifacij II. coeteroquin

page.notes: The drop cap D is joined to the first word, read as DUm. The mark "*" before Appellationis and the left-margin note "* Supra c.1.§.9." are linked by that mark. The section heading "Augustinum Bonifacio..." is set in italics and carries the marginal "Sect.I." Running head is the title only; the printed "Cap.4." at the right is left out.
